main_text.head: Summae Controversiarum RELIGIONIS. Liber Primus, DE GENTILISMO.

p.i: Multa huc spectantia rejiciuntur in Tractatum alium. Interim necessitas harum disputationum commendatur, & argumenti praesentis Scriptores, antiqui & posteriores, recensentur. Schema & series controversiarum cum Gentilibus.

main_text.p: VUm constitutum nobis sit, singulari tractatu agere de Conversione Ethnicorum, ubi data opera in statum Gentilismi, praecipuè hodierni, sumus inquisituri; tum disputationem, ac denique de eorum conversione dissertationem instituturi, illa quae eò spectant, jam omittere, & in ipsum locum servare visum, annotatis hic duntaxat controversiarum hujus argumenti capitibus, quantum studioso scire ad disputandum, & tum ad studia, tum collegia elenctica instituenda necesse videbitur. Neque omnino abs re in hoc negotio, quod sulcus

page.notes: The woodcut initial is read as "V" (Vum); the last word of the page, "quod" followed by a partly legible word on the next line ("multos"-like, shown as "sulcus"), is uncertain and should be checked. Several words in the title and the first paragraph are set in italic and show slight blur; readings such as "Ethnicorum" and "statum" are doubtful. The stray dots and marks in the margins and the show-through are not printed text.
